findings.summary: Orphaned dead code file — no longer imported
findings.detail: The file exports validateCardIconImageConflict which was the card tag's custom icon/image conflict rule. After migrating to declarative mutuallyExclusiveWith on the card definition, the import was removed from card.types.ts but the file itself was not deleted. It is dead code that should be cleaned up.

findings.summary: Unused TagValidationContext import in 3 rule files
findings.detail: Three rule files (validateDuplicateAttributes.rule.ts, validateEmptyRequiredAttributeValue.rule.ts, validatePositionalAttributeAllowedValues.rule.ts) import TagValidationContext alongside TagValidationRuleFn but only use TagValidationRuleFn directly. The context type is inferred through the function type, making the explicit TagValidationContext import unused.
findings.correction: Change the import to: import { TagValidationRuleFn } from '../types';
